statement.p: Find positive numbers a and b so that the change of variables s=ax, t=by transforms the integral \int\int_R \,dx\,dy into \int\int_T \left\vert \frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(s,t)}\right\vert\,ds\,dt for the region R, the elliptical region x^2/4 + y^2/36\le 1 and the region T, the circle s^2 + t^2 = 1.

static.solution:
S is defined by the inequality s^2 + t^2 = a^2x^2+b^2y^2 \le 1 that corresponds to the inequality x^2/4 + y^2/36\le 1 that defines R. Thus a^2=1/4 and b^2 = 1/36. We have a=1/2, b=1/6.
With this transformation we also have x = 2 s and y = 6 t, so \left\vert \frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(s,t)}\right\vert = \left\vert\begin{array}{cc} 2 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 6 \end{array}\right\vert = 12.
